title: Share of ocean litter that is abandoned fishing gear

source.name: Abandoned, Lost or Discarded Fishing Gear
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) / UN Environment Programme (UNEP)

notes: A joint FAO/UNEP assessment found abandoned, lost or discarded fishing gear makes up about 10% of all marine litter, or roughly 640,000 metric tons a year; FAO repeated the estimate in a 2021 article.
